Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15/10/2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) for various project-based research positions under advertisement number IITD/IRD/260/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Project Scientist and Project Attendant, with a total of 2 vacancies open for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for Project Scientist?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication with a minimum 8 CGPA, along with hands-on experience in sensor interfacing, PCB design, and electromechanical system design.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Project Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Attendant position must possess a BSc in physics with a solid background in sensor characterization and instrumentation systems.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Scientist?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Scientist position ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month plus HRA, structured across multiple increment steps.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed applications by email to Prof. Shahid Malik is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the official IRD website, fill it out completely, and send it via email with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates applying for the Project Scientist and Project Attendant positions at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Delhi project posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their educational qualifications and requirements, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application website?
faq.answer: You can check the official IRD website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec for downloading the application form and reviewing full notification details.
